integrity: Symbolic computation reproduces characteristic polynomial; infinite-time proof uses ergodic/Perron arguments. No independent audit or publication-priority claim.
scientific_limitations: Linear density-independent strictly semelparous two-stage projection; strictly positive starting stages; symmetric seasonal Markov switching. Generalization to primitive matrices or finite demographic stochasticity unproved.
title: Periodic rescue and random-switching extinction in a two-stage semelparous population
